name: Cisco Certified Network Associate Cybersecurity
realExamNote: Based on the 200-201 CCNACBR v1.2 exam topics. The exam was formerly called CyberOps Associate (CBROPS); Cisco renamed the certification CCNA Cybersecurity in February 2026. The real exam is 120 minutes.
scoreNote: Cisco doesn't publish an official passing score; 825 of 1000 is the commonly cited target.
